The test itself is wrong: `trunc_shift(off, V, n, sign)` computes trunc(off + sign*sqrt(V)/n) — note the division by n. In my test I compared against `(D(off) + sqrt(V))/n` (dividing off by n too). Let me fix the test: want = int((D(off) + sign*D(V).sqrt())/1 ... no:

trunc_shift(offset, radicand, n, sign) = trunc(offset + sign*sqrt(radicand)/n).

So the Decimal comparison should be: val = D(off) + (sqrt(V) if sign>0 else -sqrt(V))/D(n) → trunc.

Let me fix the test.
